description: Sends feedback, an idea, a blocker, or a bug about SeatWiFi (the website, the Chrome extension, the data, or this MCP server) to the SeatWiFi team. Use it when the user asks, and when you hit a problem yourself: a tool error, missing or wrong data, a missing tool, or unclear docs. Send one item for each issue and do not repeat it. Do not use it to report the WiFi on a flight: that is different data.

email.description: Optional. The user's email, only if they give it and want a reply.

message.description: The feedback. For a bug, say what happened, what was expected, and where (page, tool, flight).

page_url.description: Optional. The seatwifi.com page the feedback is about.

type.description: "bug" for something broken or wrong, or a blocker; "feature" for an idea or feature request; "feedback" for anything else

name: submit_feedback
title: Send feedback to SeatWiFi
